title: Himeji City Museum of Art — long-term closure notice

facts.fact: Museum interiors are closed for major air-conditioning renovation from April2026 to endDecember2027, tentatively; the front garden has separate access and possible temporary closures.
The closure is the reason the art museum is not one of the guide's five recommended visits; limited outreach events do not establish general gallery reopening.
